name: ap_payment_preparation_xa_rollback
description: Failure workflow for ap_exception_resolution. It rolls back the active XA payment-preparation transaction, including the AP state, payment instruction, and TxEventQ publication. External settlement starts only after COMMIT.

tasks.name: Rollback_Payment_Preparation_XA_Transaction
tasks.description: Instructs the MicroTx coordinator to roll the XA transaction back. The AP invoice write, payment instruction, and TxEventQ message are discarded together.

inputParameters.terminationReason: Payment-preparation XA transaction rolled back; no invoice state, payment instruction, or settlement event persisted.
